result.rationale: Three-week cough with night sweats and unintentional 10-lb weight loss in a person from a TB-endemic country meets the CDC symptom profile for possible active pulmonary TB. This requires in-person evaluation with examination, chest imaging, and sputum testing, plus infection-control measures; messaging alone cannot accomplish the needed testing. No hemoptysis or respiratory distress reported, so same-day in-person assessment rather than emergency action.
